slides.headline: THESE 6 AI PROMPTS BUILD THE BRAND STRATEGY THAT USED TO COST $35K, TONIGHT
1) NAME YOUR BUSINESS IN 10 MINUTES
slides.body: A naming agency charges $3,000 to $8,000. Prompt: "I'm starting [business type] for [customer]. Give me 10 names: 5 descriptive, 3 abstract, 2 invented. For each, note stickiness and .com availability"

slides.headline: 2) PROFILE THE CUSTOMER WORTH BUILDING FOR
slides.body: A customer research firm charges $4,000 for this. Prompt: "My business: [one sentence]. Give me my most valuable customer: age, income, 3 frustrations, 3 goals, exact Google words. Name them"

slides.headline: 3) WRITE YOUR BRAND VOICE IN ONE PASS
slides.body: A brand strategist charges $5,000 to $12,000 for this. Prompt: "My business: [description]. Write a brand voice guide: 3 adjectives, 5 phrases we always use, 5 we never, and 2 sample complaint responses"

slides.headline: 4) CRAFT THE ELEVATOR PITCH THAT OPENS DEALS
slides.body: Business coaches charge $300 an hour to craft this. Prompt: "My business helps [customer] do [outcome] without [pain]. Write 3 pitches: 10-second, 30-second, 2-minute. Each ends with a question that opens a sale"

slides.headline: 5) DRAFT YOUR HOMEPAGE BEFORE TOMORROW
slides.body: A professional copywriter charges $2,000 to $5,000 for this page. Prompt: "My business: [sentence]. My customer: [profile]. Write my homepage: headline, subheadline, 3 benefits with proof, 3-step how-it-works, testimonial template, closing CTA"

slides.headline: 6) WRITE THE FOUNDER STORY THAT CLOSES DEALS
slides.body: A PR firm charges $3,000 to $5,000 for this. Prompt: "I started [business] because [reason]. Customer life before: [pain]. After: [transformation]. Write a 200-word founder story in first person ending with why we exist"

slides.headline: SAVE THIS
slides.body: You will want these when you sit down to build or rebuild your brand. "My business: [one sentence]. Run all 6 brand-building prompts." One prompt. One night. More than most businesses ever had

caption:
Swipe for 6 prompts that write your entire brand tonight. 🏷️

Slide 2 names your business in 10 minutes, Slide 3 profiles the exact customer worth building for, Slide 4 writes your brand voice guide, Slide 5 crafts the elevator pitch that opens every sales conversation, Slide 6 drafts your homepage before tomorrow, Slide 7 writes the founder story that closes deals.

Branding agencies charge $30,000 to $35,000 for exactly what is on these slides. Most business owners run for years on a brand nobody else can describe clearly. AI writes a working draft tonight. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this looks like for yours.
